title: Incorrect package name in version lookup
detail: The __getattr__ implementation returns the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing incorrect version reporting and potential failures when the attribute is accessed.

title: Potential AttributeError on response.flags
detail: The code assumes that any non‑Failure response object has a `flags` attribute. If `response` is a plain object without `flags`, accessing `response.flags` will raise an AttributeError, causing the timeout handler to crash.
